subject: The sign-in email of your M'Arte account has been changed
preview: Your M'Arte account now signs in with a different email address.
heading: Email address changed
message: The email address you sign in to your M'Arte account with has just been changed to {email}, after the change was confirmed from the new address.
messageSecondary: From now on we will send messages about your account and your orders to the new address, and none to this one. Your orders, saved addresses and the rest of your account stay with the account. Every device that was signed in to the account has been signed out, except the one the change was finished on.
security: If you did not ask for this change, someone may be trying to take over your account. Reply to this email, write to {email} or call {phone} straight away, and we will help you secure the account.
